subject.title: Feature: Add maxSubagentResultChars to truncate subagent results injected into parent session

question: Should subagent completion result text be bounded by a new public config key, by an existing/internal context limit, or replaced by the broader metadata-only completion contract?
rationale: The code path is clear, but AGENTS.md and VISION.md put a high bar on new config surface and the related open issue asks for a broader default contract change.

options.title: Choose bounded completion contract first
options.body: Prefer a small default/internal cap or metadata envelope, and add a public config key only if maintainers decide users need to tune it.

options.title: Add `maxSubagentResultChars`
options.body: Accept the issue's proposed public setting, with schema/help/docs/tests and upgrade proof for fresh and existing configs.

options.title: Defer to metadata-only issue
options.body: Treat this cap as a stopgap and move all remaining work to the broader completion-isolation design in `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975`.

recommendation.title: Choose bounded completion contract first
recommendation.body: Prefer a small default/internal cap or metadata envelope, and add a public config key only if maintainers decide users need to tune it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work touched the same subagent internal-event and output surfaces, and this decision crosses runtime behavior plus config/product policy.
